items.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Stock Trades At A Premium On Bigger Shareholder Returns
items.summary: Lam Research has delivered very strong gains over the past few years, which puts a lot of weight on one question for investors who care about valuation. Given that history, is the current share price properly grounded in the company’s earnings power today and what the market expects it to earn over time? Over the past 5 years, Lam Research has returned about 372%, which puts a spotlight on whether that kind of outcome is already fully reflected in the earnings profile investors are paying...
